task17_decision: MANUSCRIPT CORE SURVIVES WITH MAJOR REVISION
ordering_attestation: Written and hashed before any Task 18 metric was produced. Prior inspection was limited to artifact key structure and data availability (which keys and strata exist), not to metric computation. Values quoted inside this registration as verification targets are Task 17 figures being checked, not Task 18 outputs.
sa12_treatment: Documentary/statistical review only; no empirical computation; addressed as a terminology and review note.
prohibited_operations: changing features, cohorts, splits, labels or hyperparameters
creating or editing a manuscript version

environment_constraint.finding: Frozen prediction arrays are absent from this checkout: no .npy files exist, there is no artifacts/ directory, and data/ contains only README.md. This matches the repository's documented policy that original CSVs, fitted models and artifacts are ignored and not distributed.
environment_constraint.consequence: Interval-level rescoring of frozen predictions cannot be performed in this environment. Task 18 therefore operates exclusively on frozen published aggregates.
environment_constraint.method_substitution: SA01 is executed as an exact Mann-Whitney decomposition of the already-frozen pooled and per-calendar-year payoff AUCs rather than as a month-stratified rescoring. SA06 is executed as a derivation of entry bounds from the frozen per-horizon truncation counts and the protocol exclusion rule, corroborated by frozen per-year facility counts, rather than as a direct entry-timestamp histogram.
environment_constraint.residual_gap: Calendar-MONTH stratified payoff AUC and the literal entry-month histogram remain unexecuted and require the local frozen arrays.

cif_cohort.definition: First eligible evaluation interval per facility

metrics.joint_log_loss: Frozen multinomial joint log loss over monthly risk intervals, classes none/default/payoff.
metrics.payoff_auc: Frozen monthly cause-vs-rest payoff AUC (Mann-Whitney concordance).
metrics.cif: Frozen horizon CIF: observed Aalen-Johansen reference and mean predicted facility-level CIF.

aggregation_rules.calendar_grouping: Evaluation calendar years 2019-2026 as frozen in stability.calendar; 2026 is partial (Jan-Feb).
aggregation_rules.interval_weighting: Equal weight per monthly risk interval; year weight = year intervals / total evaluation intervals.
aggregation_rules.decomposition_identity: Weighted mean of per-year deltas must reconstruct the frozen paired joint log-loss delta within 1e-12; failure to reconcile invalidates the decomposition and must be reported as such.
aggregation_rules.auc_decomposition_identity: Pooled AUC equals the pair-count-weighted average of within-stratum AUC and between-stratum AUC, where within-stratum pairs for year y number cases_y * controls_y and cases_y = payoffs_y, controls_y = intervals_y - payoffs_y. Between-stratum AUC is solved from the identity.

eligibility_rules.auc_stratum_eligibility: A calendar stratum is eligible for within-stratum payoff AUC only if the frozen artifact records a non-null payoff_auc with payoff_status SUPPORTED, which requires both classes present and the frozen auc_min_events threshold of 20 met. Strata without a frozen AUC are excluded and counted; no AUC is imputed or invented for any stratum.
eligibility_rules.default_auc_suppression: Frozen SPARSE_CAUSE_SUPPRESSED strata are reported as suppressed and never imputed.

decision_independent_reporting_rule: All four authorized analyses are reported in full regardless of whether their results favour or undermine the manuscript's current framing. No horizon, calendar stratum, population or resampling unit may be selected as headline on the basis of its result. Every authorized analysis receives one status from CONFIRMED / REFUTED / QUALIFIED / INCONCLUSIVE, assigned before any manuscript consequence is drafted.
two_thousand_twenty_interpretation_rule: Permitted: statements that deterioration is concentrated in 2020, that it is not exclusive to 2020 where other years retain positive differences, and that the full-period magnitude is unrepresentative of a typical evaluation year. Prohibited: any claim that COVID caused the failure. Task 11's distinction between a pandemic-only explanation (NOT_SUPPORTED) and pandemic-dominated magnitude is preserved.
block_resampling_rule: Any year-block resampling is performed on frozen per-year aggregates, not intervals, and is reported as sensitivity only. With eight blocks full-period and seven ex-2020, including a partial 2026, percentile coverage is weak and no percentile interval from seven blocks is to be presented as strong frequentist evidence. The aggregate-level method is validated by checking whether it approximately reproduces the frozen full-period calendar interval before being applied ex-2020.
hypothesis_labelling_rule: Explanations for the unseen-vintage reversal (seasoning, duration support, cohort encoding, composition, macro support, calendar regime) are labelled HYPOTHESIS unless directly demonstrated by frozen evidence. The primary SA03 result is the existence of the sign reversal and the population to which it applies.
